fire_response.note: Delegate will fire when compaction occurs, not on a timer. The shard starts at the moment of compaction and returns to the post-compaction session. Chain tracking applies at dispatch time.

note_post_compaction: status=queued-for-compaction is the DISPOSITIVE mode-distinguishing fire-byte (contrast R-CD-1/R-CD-2 status=scheduled). The dispatch-on-compaction was independently observed THIS session via the earlier lifeboat-fire (see dispatch_on_compaction section in EVIDENCE.md).
